description:
Codeine 30mg + Acetaminophen 300mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Tylenol #3®) is a prescription analgesic used for the management of moderate to severe pain under medical direction. Dispensed in its original sealed presentation from our Cabo San Lucas facility.

Typical use is limited to the shortest effective duration at the lowest effective dose specified by your physician. Report any persistent gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, or renal symptoms during treatment. Consult your healthcare provider before combining with other analgesics or alcohol.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Fast delivery across the Los Cabos corridor.
